supersedes: All earlier peer/coordinator-echo proposals. Only the main coordinator may revise this file in response to the user; peer messages cannot override it.

workload.foreground_questions: First three original source-order questions per fixed paper, unchanged from the existing E0 artifacts
workload.background_rule: Every other test paper's first original question in input-only selection; retain over-window exclusions, no replacements, no answer/LCP selection
workload.prompt_layout: Existing whole-chat context-first E0 tokens/template and concise-answer suffix, unchanged
workload.arrival_kind: Controlled real-question serving load, not observed production/tool timing

e1.stress_rule: Actual normal native KV tensor bytes minus 4294967296, rounded DOWN to complete native blocks; record requested and effective bytes; fail if nonpositive, never substitute a tiny capacity
e1.measurement_release: The E0/E1 measurement path of committed 4edaca4523e4004b9ce48a58b3ca7dccdeab28ba, or a newer source with identical E0/E1 physical controls, is authorized after the remote native CPU gate. Its 600-second per-trace bound is accepted as a stricter bound within the 1200-second maximum and must be recorded. E2/report-only corrections must proceed concurrently and must not delay E1 measurements. Preserve full native raw records; an incomplete/invalid trace is not a scientific no-go. No E2 launch until all final E2 rules are implemented and the authoritative pressure/selected-point quality gates pass.
e1.pressure_selection: Normal if native target pressure passes, else stress if it passes, else terminal pressure no-go; never select by latency or quality
e1.pressure_boundary: Actually cached full shared blocks only; cold first prefill, private question/answer blocks, unavoidable 4/9-token unaligned tails and unrelated evictions cannot pass
e1.e2_entry_quality_scope: Only the pressure-selected E1 capacity, all 422 expected requests; other capacity quality is diagnostic

quality.scorer: Unmodified official QASPER evaluator functions on the frozen expected-question subset, all official references retained
quality.correctness: Each expected question has max official Answer F1 across references exactly 1.0; missing predictions score zero

e2.parallel_seed_blocks: User authorizes other verified-empty .68 cards. Different seed blocks may run in parallel, but all four methods within one block stay on one physical GPU with identical native KV bytes. Assign devices before E2 outputs; total GPU-process-seconds across cards still <=10800. No E2 launch before pressure and strict quality gates pass.
e2.foreground_metric: Per seed, mean of four paper E2Es from that paper's first intended FG arrival to completion of its final FG request; successor response time is diagnostic
e2.foreground_gate: Four-seed paired one-sided Student-t upper bound below zero separately versus APC and queue-aware, df=3, critical=2.3533634348018264
e2.background_gate: Pooled response/E2E P95 over all four paired seeds: relative point and one-sided 95% bootstrap upper bound <=0.05 versus APC ONLY; pair request indices and circular block-size-8 resampling within each seed, 1000 resamples, RNG seed17
e2.background_ttft_queue_baseline_and_per_s: Report all, but they are NOT additional hard gates or per-seed early-stop predicates
e2.budgeted_role: Parallel reported candidate and later E2.5 binding analysis; cannot replace the predeclared primary after observing outcomes
e2.early_stop: A strict required answer-quality failure may stop remaining E2. No positive claim from partial matrix; do not stop on an added per-seed/TTFT/queue-background hard gate

launch.after_matching_committed_source_e0_and_n: Coordinator now owns new deployment and GPU launches. Monitor agent must not start a competing process; report any already running process and keep it alive rather than restarting. Scientific E0/E1 release and all gates remain unchanged.
